_comment: POPULATED REFERENCE manifest showing the tools AI4IA can place in a toolbox via azure-ai-projects. This is an EXAMPLE only (the canonical live toolbox is foundry/toolbox.manifest.json). To use it, copy this over toolbox.manifest.json (or pass --manifest foundry/toolbox.manifest.example.json), prune the tools you do not want, create the referenced connections, then run scripts/provision-foundry-toolbox.py. Every tool listed here is consumed through the official-MCP APIM front door once the toolbox is registered in infra/mcp-servers.json. Note: computer_use and bing_custom_search are agent-level tools with no toolbox equivalent in the SDK, so they are not toolbox tools. The service allows at most one unnamed tool total, so every tool here is named. All tools are Azure public preview.
name: ai4ia-toolbox
description: AI4IA shared Foundry toolbox (populated reference). Groups grounding, code execution, browsing, and tool search behind one APIM-fronted MCP endpoint.

tools.name: ai4ia-rag
tools.description: RAG over the AI4IA AI Search index. Requires the 'ai4ia-search' project connection.

tools.name: code-interpreter
tools.description: Foundry-managed sandboxed Python (distinct from AI4IA's existing direct Responses-API code interpreter).

tools.name: custom-code-interpreter
tools.description: Custom code interpreter: runs a BYO container image in the Foundry sandbox.

tools.name: browser
tools.description: Drive a hosted browser (preview; heavier isolation review recommended).

tools.name: tool-search
tools.description: Tool search: lets the model pick from a large tool set. Add so the toolbox self-describes its tools.
